findings.claim: Generated partial formatter is emitted via the normal string-key/int-key templates for a type with a parameterless constructor and no MessagePackSecurity changes, but the generator never validates that the formatter ctor path honours MessagePackSecurity: deserialization for contractless string-key objects relies on the existing template, which calls options.Security.DepthStep. No new bypass is introduced. However, contractless mode serializes all public read-write members including those typed as interfaces/abstract types from the untrusted referenced assembly, with no analyzer check (MsgPack005-like) on member types, so deserializing untrusted data can reach unvetted polymorphic/unsupported member types at runtime rather than compile time.

receipt_plan.detail: Read GeneratedFormatterCollector.CreateMember/CreateContractlessMembers: member types are not validated for formatter availability (no TypeCollector.CollectCore call), so MsgPack003/005-style diagnostics are skipped for member types.
